symptom: `mxcli widget docs` omits all but the first widget of a bundled multi-widget `.mpk` (e.g. Charts.mpk emits only `areachart.md`; ColumnChart/BarChart/PieChart/LineChart/BubbleChart missing)
cause: Same class as #679 in an unfixed code path: `RegenerateWidgetDocs` used `mpk.ParseMPK` (returns `WidgetFiles[0]` only), while the def-generation loop (`RefreshWidgetDefinitions`) already used `ParseMPKAll`. Charts.mpk bundles 10 widgetFiles
insight: Swap the per-`.mpk` `ParseMPK` for `ParseMPKAll` and loop over every returned `mpkDef` (mirror the def-gen loop). Test `TestRegenerateWidgetDocsMultiWidgetMPK` (uses the `testdata/expr-checker/widgets/Charts.mpk` fixture). Bug 9a
